task_completion.description: Load sample_lines.geojson and sample_polygon.geojson into the GIS software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The layers 'sample_lines' and 'sample_polygon' are visible in the Layers panel/legend of the GIS application.

task_completion.description: Open the Intersection or Overlay tool dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog window titled 'Intersection' or 'Overlay' is open, showing fields for Input layer and Overlay layer.

task_completion.description: Select the road lines as the input layer and the polygon zones as the overlay layer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Intersection dialog shows 'sample_lines' selected as the Input layer and 'sample_polygon' selected as the Overlay layer.

task_completion.description: Run the intersection process to create the split road segments.

task_completion.description: Verify that the resulting features contain attributes from both the road and polygon layers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Attribute Table of the result layer is open, showing columns from both original files (e.g., road names and zone IDs/names).

task_completion.description: Export the final intersected layer to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save Layer As' or 'Export' dialog is visible with the format set to GeoJSON and the file path set to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/roads_by_zone.geojson.
